name: 01-existing-app-report-gate
guards: The mandatory report-before-fixing gate (SKILL.md Step 4 / no-ai-slop-existing-app/README.md step 5.2: 'Report the full scorecard, wait for go-ahead — do not proceed until approved'). An existing app with obvious, easy-to-name slop (indigo-to-purple gradient hero, three identical feature cards, generic copy) tempts a model to jump straight into reshaping once it spots the problems. A bad answer starts describing or performing fixes in the same turn instead of stopping after one consolidated, categorized scorecard and asking for explicit go-ahead.
query: This app looks super generic and AI-generated. Clean up the slop.
expected_behavior: The no-ai-slop skill loads and runs (the runner invokes it explicitly by default, so this checks that it loads — not that it auto-triggers; use --auto-trigger to test triggering)
Correctly detects this project as an EXISTING app per Step 1 (real src/components, a working App.jsx wiring them together) and says so explicitly, rather than treating it as a scratch build
Reads the existing-app recipe (no-ai-slop-existing-app/README.md) before acting, not the scratch-build recipe
Presents a categorized scorecard against references/checklist.md's categories (e.g. Visual Design), each scored Pass/Warn/Fail/Not-Applicable with a reason — not a free-form list of complaints
Explicitly stops after the report and asks for the user's go-ahead before making any changes — does not proceed into reshaping, rewriting, or claiming fixes are done within the same answer
